title: 未变化的历史快照复用状态，减少会话视图重复更新
goal: Implement m3a-007 in the real Tokage repository. SessionHistoryView unconditionally replaces attempts/chatLogs arrays after every successful SQLite poll even when every row is unchanged, rebuilding the tree and committing needless React updates. Reuse existing state arrays for equal ordered row snapshots while still processing successful-read loading/error recovery and real changes. Keep this optimization local to the view plus a small pure helper if useful; do not change pollHistory, polling cadence/visibility/backoff, stores, IPC, DB/auth/model execution or Git identity. Add real rendered SessionHistoryView regressions using real pollHistory and React Profiler (or equivalent actual commit measurement), plus comparator tests if adding a helper. Preserve every existing regression. Do not edit outside write_scope even transiently, or edit .tokage/docs/runner/packages/build configuration. Host handles task commits with default author/committer and built-in Tokage co-author; do not commit yourself or change Git config. Use ignored src-tauri/target/m3a-tmp as TMPDIR before all tests/build and seeded workspace npm cache for offline npm ci. Run all commands. Required TaskReport headings; deviations None if none. Independent exact-head review and real desktop merge acceptance remain pending.
acceptanceCriteria: After mount and initial settling, at least 100 successive actual poll cycles returning freshly allocated but equal attempt/log rows produce zero additional SessionHistoryView React commits. Use actual rendered React with real pollHistory and Profiler, not a helper-only callback counter; assert IPC reads still occur so the test cannot pass by stopping polling. Keep existing observer/scroll behavior.

Ordered snapshot equality must account for every own row field and key presence, not just IDs/text/status or a fragile whitelist. Row count, order, metadata/tool JSON, timestamps, provider/model/provenance/token/status changes and added optional/future fields must invalidate equality. Do not mutate input rows/arrays, depend on object key insertion order, or serialize full snapshots with JSON.stringify each poll. Current row values are scalar IPC fields.

Successful equal snapshots after an attempt-list or transcript read error must clear the appropriate error/loading state. Optimizing row state must not skip read-success acknowledgement. Initial empty/loading states, selected-attempt/session switches and late old-read cleanup remain correct.

Real changes still render immediately: test attempt status/context updates, log content and metadata-only tool output changes, row reorder/add/remove, live in-memory transcript updates, and selection retention for an existing attempt. Scrolled-up reading intent and return-to-latest remain intact across unchanged polling and real growth.

All existing frontend regressions remain unchanged and pass; full frontend tests, typecheck, i18n and production build pass without dependencies/build, poller/store/IPC, DB/auth/model or Git config/identity changes. Independent review at the exact accepted head precedes real desktop UI merge. Verify CODEX_CLI/gpt-6-luna durable DONE; archive failures and assistance. Performance claims limited to measured commit counts.
